purpose: Test a higher-precision alternative to the failed BF16 ESMC speed policy: FP16 final-layer ESMC plus the previously validated FP16 feed-forward folding-head policy and strict FP32 decoder
reference: Complete strict-FP32 online run 49470256; same checkpoint, ESMC files, data, seed, batches, target correspondence, 25 steps, CFG 2 and three samples
rationale: FP16 retains more significand precision than BF16 and may pass the unchanged shape controls while using tensor cores. Benefit is unknown; finite outputs alone do not qualify.
controls: All eight existing online batch/padding controls must pass without changing thresholds. Then score all 626 development proteins and 1878 predictions, with fresh ESMC embeddings.
accuracy_gate: Paired sequence-cluster lower confidence bounds above -0.005 for TM and CA lDDT; upper bounds at most +0.001 for geometry-outlier fractions against the full FP32 online reference
speed_gate: At least 2x measured sequence-to-three-backbone collection throughput versus the matched FP32 online run, including tokenization, ESMC, head, decoder and coordinate transfer. Report SM active, instruction issue, peak memory, and complete allocated walltime separately.
interpretation: An inference speed/accuracy tradeoff, not a training-recipe accuracy gain. No optimized speed ratio against ESMFold2 is inferred. Three-sample selection is outside this timed collection and must be included before a deployment timing claim.
failure_action: Preserve any failed numerical control and stop this attempt. Do not relax tolerances.
final_test: Keep the 34 locked structures unscored. No earlier-layer computation.
